question: Based on the World Bank global population dataset and the World Bank health nutrition population dataset, how many countries experienced an increase of more than 1% from the previous year to 2018 in both their total population and per capita current health expenditure (PPP)?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as country_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    p.country_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population` h2017
    ON p.country_code = h2017.country_code 
    AND h2017.indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' 
    AND h2017.year = 2017
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population` h2018
    ON p.country_code = h2018.country_code 
    AND h2018.indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' 
    AND h2018.year = 2018
  WHERE p.year_2017 IS NOT NULL 
    AND p.year_2018 IS NOT NULL
    AND p.year_2017 != 0
    AND h2017.value IS NOT NULL
    AND h2018.value IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_DIVIDE(p.year_2018 - p.year_2017, p.year_2017) * 100 > 1
    AND SAFE_DIVIDE(h2018.value - h2017.value, h2017.value) * 100 > 1
    AND p.country_code NOT IN (
      'AFE', 'AFW', 'ARB', 'CEB', 'CSS', 'EAR', 'HIC', 'HPC', 'IBT', 'IDB', 'LAC', 'LDC', 'LIC', 'LMC', 'LMY',

      'SSA', 'TSA'
    )
